title: It's a Lonely Place Hoodie
description:
XXXTentacion's 2018 album "Skins" featured a song with Ye, called "One Minute". As a part of the album release, Yeezy created a three-piece merchandise capsule including a long sleeve tee, a short sleeve tee, and this hoodie. While not officially released for Season 6, the items in the One Minute merch capsule all used Season 6 blank garments.

Printed on a Season 6 glacier hoodie blank. Quality varies due to reprints created on lower-quality hoodies using the same cut. The original production run used the white Season 6 tags.
100% Cotton
Released on December 13th, 2018, on https://shopxxxtentacion.com/.
